notes: The capstone (12.4) gains a deployed variant: a pipeline builds the evidence, an agent proposes one action, you approve it on your phone, and the system carries it out and logs it, at a URL interviewers can open. It also explains why a plain document chatbot no longer stands out.
Chapter 11 lists what forward deployed teams expect in the first months and links to that capstone.
The Databricks map (8.3) adds Lakebase, Databricks Apps and Agent Bricks: what each is and what to use it for.
Reels open faster: the reel scripts now download one module at a time and stay saved on your device, so the Reels tab no longer waits for a large download each visit.
1295 of 1315 reels now play in the natural Heart voice.
